title: Editorial Plan
description: Structured output of the Stage-4 editorial pass. The pass never edits files: it emits this plan and scripts/apply_editorial_plan.py applies it deterministically, then scripts/check_editorial_diff.py verifies that only prose moved. One action rewrites one prose field or one verbatim block; every other byte of the model is out of reach by construction.

schema_version.description: Bumped only when the schema breaks backwards compatibility.

generated.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp written by the editorial pass.

status.description: `no_change` means the pass read the projection and found nothing worth rewriting. It requires an empty `actions` array.

file.description: Path relative to $OUTPUT_DIR. The applier hard-rejects anything else; the six force-regenerated fragments are excluded because the next compose overwrites them.

path.description: Field address such as `threats[12].scenario` or `mitigations[3].steps[1]`. Required for the yaml and JSON targets, forbidden for the Markdown fragment. The applier accepts only addresses on the editable allow-list in scripts/check_editorial_diff.py.

find.description: For a field address, the field's current value verbatim — it is the optimistic lock, and a mismatch rejects the action. For the Markdown fragment, a block that occurs exactly once.

replace.description: The rewritten prose. Identifiers, links, code spans, paths, `file:line` locators and numbers must survive unchanged; check_editorial_diff.py reverts the run when they do not.

rationale.description: One sentence, surfaced in the applier's log so a maintainer can audit the judgement.
